segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: etc. So, ang tatanong ko sa COA,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: please, no holds barred po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Pwede nyo po bang sabihin kung

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Pwede nyo rin sabihin, kahit sa

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: harap ni Chairman JV, hindi po ako

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: sa mga nakita po ng COA.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I don't know if this has been

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: yung reason kung ba't sa Bulacan po kami

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: How many projects? Kung ilan po ito?

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Marami po ito. But so far

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: ang fraud audit po namin, tuloy-tuloy

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So far, nasa almost 50 na po kami.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: And then, iba-iba po yung nakita namin.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: But marami po sa kanila talagang defective or non-existent.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So, yun po ang aming naging conclusion doon sa fraud audit.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So, we issued notice of disallowances.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: And we already submitted this to the Office of the Ombudsman.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Dati po, nung nandiyan pa po yung ICI, we submitted the ICI to the Office of the Ombudsman also.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Now, doon po kasi sa mga NDs that we issued and sa flood control projects,

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: meron po kasi dyan tinatawag na persons liable.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So, makikita po namin, we can submit it to you, we can submit it to the Honorable Finance Committee.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: At makikita po nyo yung mga persons liable, nandoon naman po.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: It's really the DPWH people yung po nag-i-implement.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Because it's the budget of the DPWH and it's their personnel po sa Bulacan.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Wala naman po si Sen. Joel doon at hindi naman siya implement or he's a legislator.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Would you know if there are projects being pushed by politicians in these particular areas na inaudit ninyo?

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: But what we see is yung implementing agency which is the DPWH po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Can we also ask, dito sa 50 fraudulent, I mean 50 fraud audits, yung breakdown po binabanggit nyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: some were ghosts, some were, do we have a breakdown already?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kung ilan doon yung talagang ghosts, yung ilan doon yung substandard, extremely substandard materials yung ginamit?

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: We don't have it right now but we can submit po.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So far po, majority po, wala po siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: With the indulgence of Sen. Villanueva, siguro Chairman Lielo, we would like to, can you submit to the committee

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: yung list ng inyo pong investigation on which projects are found to be irregular, yung pong may ghosts,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: or basta hindi po substandard because our policy right now in this budget hearings is to resume flood

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: control projects to complete the uncompleted ones.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi nakita naman natin ang naging epekto ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Because for 2026 talagang ziniro, flood control, ang nangyari tuloy talagang may mga puwang, may mga gaps, mga uncompleted.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So which were said, kasi naipon mo yung tubig pero puwapasok naman yung tubig.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So our instruction is also to complete the uncompleted projects, tapusin yung mga dapat tapusin, close the gap,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: but we would want a list of these projects which we would, yung inyo pong nag-undergo ng investigation

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: which are found to be fraudulent, yung pong substandard para po sa amin pong pag-review

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and then we will only allow those uncompleted projects that are not irregular or fraudulent.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So we appreciate the submission of this investigation.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: We commit to submit that, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Lahat po ng aming fraud audit reports, we'll also summarize it po para po mas madali makita.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: And at the same time, we'll also submit the report na comprehensive per item.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Idagdag ko lang din po na as early as 2016, Your Honors, the Commission Audit in charge of the DPWH

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: has already issued an observation po na wala po kasing...

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: master plan yung pong paggawa ng pong flood control.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So kumbaga po kanya-kanya po siya, but I think it has to be closed.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Tama po kayo, nagkaroon ng gaps eh.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So kasi po wala master plan.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So there has to be a master plan and para lahat po nakasarado.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Otherwise po, ang nangyari po kasi...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sir, I'm a witness. My colleague here has been ranting about this year in and year out ever since 3-4 years ago.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ang problema talaga, we were going back.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I had a post 2014 on the importance of a master plan for all projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Hindi lang flood control, but I have been advocating a master plan for infrastructure and national development

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: which would include transport modernization, yung sa power, sa energy.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasaba na rin po yung water management and flood control.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siguro, Chairman Liel, yung ibang projects, sorry na lang po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kahit walang Regional Development Council approval, kahit wala sa master plan, kahit walang convergence, kahit hindi kailangan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Mukhang gano'n na lumalabas, lalo rin sa mga nag-ghost.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So in order, I think we would need your [unclear].

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: You'll be a big factor in how we will be able to bring back that confidence

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and trust, especially in this budget season, by providing us with this list.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yung pong hinihingi na api kanina.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tsaka yung pong, siguro yung pong isa tungkol sa master plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Do you think, Chairman Liel, that in case we push itong talagang may master plan pa,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: this will definitely prevent occurrence of projects that are not needed and are intended only to, alam nyo na,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So what are what we want now?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We want RDC approval or at least a provincial approval to make sure that these projects are needed.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Hindi yung basta lang po project eh para pagkakitaan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So I'm asking your guidance also and what you think na amin pong sinasagawa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: RDC approval, program of works, tapos basta po nasa flood-prone, top 10 flood-prone provinces

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: or it can be used as justification.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: There are 18 major river basins in the absence of a master plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So siguro these are the considerations that we would have in order for us to approve flood control projects this time.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siguro, ano na po, your thoughts, Chairperson?

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: Actually, sabi ko nga po sa inyo, as early as 2016, nag-issue na po ng observation ng Commission on Audit on that.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: I understand when you were mayor po of San Juan, kasi dati po ang San Juan binabahat.

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
segments.text: So I think when you were there, marami po kayong nagawa, kaya po nabawasan ito ng...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Actually, siguro, if flood control, if done right, can really be effective.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Hindi ko naman siya inaangat sa sarili.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But you know, ano to, sinasabi ko, Sen. Villanueva, ano yung sa Navotas,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: under, ano to, below sea level.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pero by placing strategic pumping stations in strategic areas, natanggal nila Toby Tiangco yung baha.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Naginaya po namin sa San Juan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We have about five or six barangays that are low-lying areas.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Basin, na kahit dalawang linggo nang walang ulan, baha pa rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Unfortunately, may isa na lang doon na naiwan, na inirata.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Na nirequest ko kay Bonoan at kay Bernardo noon na hindi pinagbigyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ayaw kasi nung congressman namin dahil ayaw nung mayor.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So may isa na lang doon nababaha.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kung meron, yun na lang yung naiwan doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So sabi ako, nagkiusap ko sa DPWH sila na kung ano pa mangyari, basta gawin nyo na lang.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So thank you for that, for yung pong sa San Juan na mention nyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And I think it was the Navotas that we followed.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Naging yung Bombastik pumps nila na kami pong ginaya.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And let me put on record that I am a living testimony of what you have been espousing here in the Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And since the time you were the mayor of the great city of San Juan, yung pinupush po ninyo na master plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At you're not only supporting me with the master plan ng flood control.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But yun nga po, ako, lagi akong supportive doon sa mga gusto nyo yung mga infrastructure projects,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: especially doon sa transportation, sa railways, etc.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kaya mapalad kayo, Senator JV, at nagawan ng paraan yung San Juan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At kami hanggang ngayon sa Bulacan, still suffering.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Literally, figuratively, physically, mentally, and sometimes spiritually.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, just to put on record, Mr. Chairman, and I'd like to give this information to our COA family headed by Chairman Cordoba.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yung po sa amin sa Bulacan, for example, doon sa Paumbong, sa Paumbong, sa Barangay Cruz,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: tsaka Barangay Masukol, eh hindi na po baha yung problema nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Na hanggang dibdib, lagpas tao, at kahit summer, bumabaha po sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ang problema po nila ngayon, unti-unti nang kinakain nung dagat, yung lupa, nung barangay.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Itong Barangay Santa Cruz, tsaka Barangay Masukol, about 3,000 siguro yung mga residents po dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: At unfortunately, sabi nga nila, hindi na yung baha problema namin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kasi kinakain na ng lupa, mabuburan na kami sa mapa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ganon din po yung kalagayan sa Hagonoy, Bulacan, sa Barangay Pugad at Barangay Tibagin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ano naman yung nangyari dito sa dalawang barangay na ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Before the fiasco, before this erupted, the kasuklam-suklam na mga pangyayari about flood control,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: meron pong breakwater at seawall dyan sa dalawang barangay na yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Pero dahil gagawin at palalakihin, patitibayin, i-strengthenin yung seawall, binakbak na po nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Sisimulan na eh, gagawin na po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Nung gagawin na po, natigil lahat ngayon ng flood control.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Nung binakbak, nasira lalo dahil bawal ang flood control, dahil maraming siraulong kurakot na dapat dyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Talagang ako, fight ako sa firing squad eh, sa mga taong ganyan eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Nung hindi po ginawa, hanggang ngayon ho, ilang taon na, na wala ho ni Pondo or anything, Mr. Chairman, wala ho at hindi na gagawa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Nagsimula na rin pong kainin ng dagat yung lupa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: To cut the story short, ito hong mga barangay na ito, sa barangay Paumbong,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ah, dun po sa bayan ng Paumbong, barangay Santa Cruz, barangay Masukol,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: sa Hagunoy, barangay Pugat, barangay Tibagin, sa Hagunoy.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Eh, hindi na po problema nila yung ba.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Ang problema nila, mawawala na po sa mapa yung kanilang mga barangay.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: There's one in barangay, Mr. Chairman, in Hagunoy,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: na I have to call the attention of the DPWH Secretary because

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I forgot the name of barangay.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: In Hagunoy, meron naman po doon kasama doon sa problema na may kaso.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And according to them, may gate po eh, may gate.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Hindi ho magamit yung gate. Bumabaha na po.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Dahil ang sabi lang daw ay hindi po pwedeng galawin yan dahil may kaso yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: The good thing, I don't know the real situation and ayokong makialam doon sa mga kaso-kasong ganyan

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Si Secretary Vince, nagutos right away, the next day ho, naggalaw po yung gate.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I don't know kung nakipag-coordinate po yata sa COA or other agencies in the government.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: But thanks to Sec. Vince, naggalaw po yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Kasi imagine, yung gate lang, ibababa lang po, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Dahil lang daw po may kaso, hindi po ginawa.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Yun lang po yung mga maliliit na bagay na gano'n.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And I hope, ang COA naman natin, hindi naman in the box yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I don't think yung COA natin, extremist yung mga COA auditors natin

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: para yung mga ganitong bagay na ito, hindi matulungan yung mga kababayan po natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: So, yun lang po, Mr. Chairman, gusto kong ipaabot sa ating mga kasama sa COA

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: na malaking tulong ang kailangan ng mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Lalo na po doon sa mga apektado ng baha.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Dahil nakakasunog ang apoy, hindi na po tayo magluluto at papatayin natin sa gutom yung ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I'm really not happy na wala hong flood control the past year program kahit na ito'y nararapat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And records will bail me out.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Hindi ako sumuporta sa mga flood control programs because hindi ko nakikita na ito'y integrated

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: And these committees in the Senate, mga senador nakasama ko at mga nakatrabaho ko,

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: alam po yung dahilan kung bakit ganito yung aking adhikain dito sa usapin nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Actually, sa totoo lang, that's why we wanted also to resume the flood control projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Dito sa monsoon rains, wala pa ngang bagyo ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tuloy-tuloy na ulan, lubog ang Metro Manila, lubog ang Bulacan, lubog ang Pampanga, hanggang Tarlac.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Well, iba na rin talaga yung climate change.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But still, we need to resume the flood-mitigating projects, especially the complete, the uncompleted.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siguro wala namang masama roon, Chairman, di ba, as long as these projects are not found to be irregular or substandard.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I think this will be more beneficial as it would prevent the further suffering of the people in Bulacan and Pampanga and even Metro Manila and Tarlac.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At least kung ma-mitigate natin, mabawasan natin yung pagbabaha, masara natin yung gaps, kasi mas masama yung may puwang eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tubig yan. Maghahanap talaga ng papasukan yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tapos pinipigilan mo namang mawala yung tubig para mawala yung baha.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So ang ano natin is to close the gaps.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And also, if I would, magsimula tayo, Senator Villanueva, yung NIA and DPWH.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in the absence of a master plan, convergence na.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And then sa taas pa lang dapat meron nang water impounding.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Tapos nakaano yan ng flood control, water impounding.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi pag tag-ulan, sobra-sobra ulan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Pag tagtuyot naman, walang-wala tayo, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So I think we should change yung view, yung view eh na yung tubig hindi dapat perwisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kailangan natin ng tamang flood water management, I think.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yun ang atin pong direksyon, di ba?

segments.speaker: COA Chairperson Gamaliel A. Cordoba
